stem: Which statement describes one way that the Bessemer process contributed to the economic development of the United States?

options.label: A
options.text: The demand for iron decreased, and iron mines closed.

options.label: B
options.text: The increase in telephone lines reduced the time to communicate over long distances.

options.label: C
options.text: The mass production of steel allowed the construction of taller buildings.

options.label: D
options.text: The development of vaccines lowered the cost of medical care.
